provider: Supplier news monitoring (mock of a news / web-search API)

articles.headline: NovaChip to close its 200 mm fab, accelerating end-of-life for legacy microcontrollers
articles.summary: NovaChip will consolidate legacy production into its 300 mm fab and has warned customers that allocation on last-time-buy orders may apply.

articles.headline: Distributors report stretched NovaChip lead times during fab transition
articles.summary: Quoted lead times for NovaChip microcontrollers have risen by several weeks as wafer starts move between fabs.

articles.headline: Crescent Semiconductor expands microcontroller capacity at its Kumamoto plant
articles.summary: The expansion adds capacity for industrial microcontrollers from the first quarter of 2027.

articles.headline: Lumen Microsystems earns automotive-grade qualification for its LMC-44 family
articles.summary: The qualification covers extended temperature range and production part approval documentation.

articles.headline: Lumen Microsystems raises new funding; revenue still concentrated in two customers
articles.summary: Analysts note the company is growing fast but remains small, with limited second-site capacity.

articles.headline: Industry alert: remarked microcontrollers traced to independent broker channels
articles.summary: Several manufacturers found remarked parts in broker stock this quarter. Buyers are advised to require full traceability and incoming inspection.

articles.headline: Typhoon briefly halts shipments from Taiwan electronics parks
articles.summary: Operations resumed within two days; no lasting impact on Atlas Electronics deliveries is expected.
